title: Strings that are a number once the underscores are removed
notes: Several Go readers remove every underscore from a plain scalar before they parse it as a number, so these strings read as numbers there, although the Core schema reads them as strings. A string that is a number once its underscores are removed is quoted. This is a writing convention of the family, not the specification: a string is written plain only when every common reader reads it as that same string, so the text is judged under the YAML 1.2 Core schema (loose) and also under YAML 1.1 and the number forms common readers accept (strict).

provenance.reference: Strings such as +_1 and 1e3_ written without quotes; Go readers that strip underscores before parsing read them as numbers.
